methodologyNotes: Covers portable and studio golf launch monitors sold to consumers at a published US price. Includes radar (Doppler), photometric camera, and radar-camera fusion units. Excludes full permanent simulator enclosures, mats, nets, and phone-only swing apps with no dedicated sensor. Price is typical US MSRP in USD (top-level priceUsd), sensor unit only, excluding subscriptions and simulator bundles. sensorType is the core measurement technology as an enum: doppler-radar, photometric-camera, or radar-camera-fusion. dataParametersCount is the integer number of ball/club data parameters the manufacturer states the unit measures or reports. spinMeasurement is an enum for how ball spin is derived: measured (directly tracked), calculated (estimated from other data), or none. clubDataMeasured is a boolean for whether the unit reports club-delivery metrics (e.g. club path, face angle, attack angle) rather than ball-only data. putterDataMeasured is a boolean for dedicated putting metrics. usageEnvironment is an enum: indoor-only, outdoor-only, or indoor-outdoor. builtInDisplay is a boolean for an integrated on-device screen (excludes paired phone/tablet). simulationSupport is a boolean for whether the unit drives course-play or range simulation software. subscriptionRequired is a boolean for whether core or simulation features need an ongoing paid subscription. batteryLifeHrs is rated battery life in hours; null if mains-powered or not disclosed. weightGrams is the sensor unit weight in grams.
